operation.description:
Shows whether immutable releases are enabled or disabled. Also identifies whether immutability is being
enforced by the repository owner.  The authenticated user must have admin read access to the repository.

200.description: Response if immutable releases are enabled

404.description: Not Found if immutable releases are not enabled for the repository

operation.summary: Check if immutable releases are enabled for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

enabled.description: Whether immutable releases are enabled for the repository.

enforced_by_owner.description: Whether immutable releases are enforced by the repository owner.
